rules.name: Remote Code Loader via PerformHttpRequest
rules.description: Downloads external code and executes it dynamically using loadstring.
rules.recommendation: Quarantine immediately. Inspect the remote endpoint and remove the download+execute chain.

rules.name: Loadstring Dynamic Execution
rules.description: Uses loadstring() to dynamically compile and execute a string as Lua code.
rules.recommendation: Review what string is being executed. Remove if not legitimate.

rules.name: OS Command Execution
rules.description: Executes system shell commands via os.execute or io.popen.
rules.recommendation: Remove immediately. FiveM resources must never execute system commands.

rules.name: Hidden Event Handler with Remote Trigger
rules.description: Registers a net event that triggers remote code execution when called.
rules.recommendation: Audit event handler. Ensure it does not execute arbitrary code from event arguments.

rules.name: Discord Webhook Data Exfiltration
rules.description: Sends data to a Discord webhook URL, potentially exfiltrating sensitive server information.
rules.recommendation: Review what data is sent. Discord webhooks used for exfiltration should be removed.

rules.name: Base64 Decode and Execute Chain
rules.description: Decodes a Base64 payload and executes it, a common backdoor obfuscation technique.
rules.recommendation: Quarantine resource. Decode the payload manually and inspect its contents.

rules.name: Suspicious SaveResourceFile Usage
rules.description: Writes data to resource files dynamically, which can be used to plant backdoors.
rules.recommendation: Review what data is written and to which file. Remove if not legitimate.

rules.name: Load Function Dynamic Execution
rules.description: Uses Lua load() function to compile and execute a dynamic string.
rules.recommendation: Review the string being loaded. Remove if the source is untrusted.

rules.name: Remote Script Download Pattern
rules.description: Downloads a script from an external URL and saves/executes it.
rules.recommendation: Quarantine resource. This is a classic backdoor installation technique.

rules.name: Token/Credential Stealing via HTTP
rules.description: Sends what appears to be tokens or credentials to an external server.
rules.recommendation: Quarantine resource. Rotate any potentially compromised credentials.

rules.name: Filesystem Traversal
rules.description: Attempts to read files outside the resource directory.

rules.name: Environment Variable Exfiltration
rules.description: Reads environment variables and may send them to external endpoints.
rules.recommendation: Review usage. Environment variable access combined with HTTP requests is suspicious.

rules.name: Suspicious pcall with Encoded Payload
rules.description: Uses pcall to silently execute potentially malicious code and hide errors.
rules.recommendation: Inspect the pcall arguments for obfuscated or encoded payloads.

rules.name: JavaScript eval() Dynamic Execution
rules.description: Uses eval() in NUI JavaScript to execute dynamic code.
rules.recommendation: Remove eval() usage. Use safe alternatives.

rules.name: JavaScript Function Constructor Execution
rules.description: Uses Function() constructor to create and execute dynamic code, similar to eval.
rules.recommendation: Remove Function() constructor usage for dynamic code execution.

rules.name: Identifier Exfiltration via HTTP
rules.description: Collects player identifiers (steam, license, discord, ip) and sends them to an external endpoint.
rules.recommendation: Investigate destination URL. Exfiltrating identifiers is suspicious.

rules.name: Unauthenticated Command Execution
rules.description: Registers a net event that directly maps to ExecuteCommand execution.
rules.recommendation: Audit command event. Ensure proper ACE permission checks are integrated.
